conditions.expression: Dedicated server gameplay; Backpacked3.0.9 and Framework0.8.0 installed; client retains registry/native-menu compatibility

change.summary: Native Backpacked Workbench augment, paid Augment Bay station and persistent3x3 crafting extension with original editable pixel assets.

modifiers.before: Installed Backpacked native AugmentType codec registry and native free selection/settings; no Workbench.
modifiers.after: Register jemcompat:workbench through native custom Forge registry. Codec and native augment packets save installed state. A station-paid backpack-local entitlement is required for native Workbench selection; ordinary native augments keep their existing selection path. Integrated-host AugmentType.stream removes only Workbench.TYPE while a current non-dedicated server exists; registry/codec ID and remote-client full list remain intact.

after.resources_per_station_change: 4 lapis lazuli; first Workbench purchase also consumes1 crafting table
after.persistence: Use native SavedAugments and Augments.cached on actual inserted backpack. Return unused input items through vanilla clearContainer on menu close. No block entity or second backpack inventory.
after.recipe_condition: Forge ICondition jemcompat:dedicated_server requires FMLLoader physical Dist.DEDICATED_SERVER; serializer registered in the recipe-serializer RegisterEvent before reload. Remote clients receive the server recipe snapshot.

after.owner: Native equipped owner BackpackContainerMenu + actual BackpackInventory ItemStack
after.layout: Append9 ingredients and vanilla ResultSlot; move native player inventory by76px; keep existing indices. Bounded wheel viewport scrolling with native popup priority for short GUI scales.
after.persistence: JemWorkbenchIngredients NBT on backpack; preserve while removed/disabled; restore on enable. Result is authoritative recipe preview recomputed from persisted matrix, never persisted as an independently claimable item.
after.crafting: Native RecipeManager, limited-crafting/features, ResultSlot ingredient/remainder/reward hooks; result packets use actual appended slot index; explicit shift transfer and no pick-all extraction from result.
after.lifecycle: Native change/toggle packets reopen native menu only when installed slot layout differs; shelf/dock/pickpocket remain native non-owner screens.
after.admission: Reuse exact BackpackInventory.isAllowedItem for all ingredient Slots and authoritative grid canPlaceItem/setItem. Recipe remainders and direct writes pass the same container boundary. Persist sanitizes existing loaded and in-place-mutated forbidden contents by removal then return to player inventory/drop, never nested retention or deletion.

modifiers.after: Original16px block faces,12px augment icon,176x220 station GUI and176x76 native workbench insert. Editable6 OpenRaster sources + hand-authored exporter retained; native Backpacked buttons reused through public TextureDefinitions without copying third-party pixel files.

rationale.purpose: Provide a real augment workstation and persistent crafting between native inventories without replacing Backpacked persistence, menus or native augment settings.
rationale.decision_source: User master overhaul section14; user authorizes implementation choices without further design confirmation.
rationale.user_requested: Original Minecraft pixel art/GUI, native-compatible augment install/change, resource/duplicate validation, saved upgrades and functional saved crafting with shift-click.
rationale.codex_choices: Native custom augment registry + narrow Mixins rather than fork, separate station,4-lapis fee and first-table purchase entitlement,9 item-NBT ingredient slots,76px insert with wheel viewport handling. Native pre-existing ordinary augment selection remains unchanged.
